metadata.audit_name: HVA-01 Human Value-Aware Case Selection Audit
metadata.mode: READ-ONLY / AUDIT ONLY / NO IMPLEMENTATION / FROZEN INTACT / STOP
metadata.predecessors: DCE-05/06/07, L5 Learning Signal Audit, Info Gain Audit, Feedback Reuse Audit, Next Direction Audit, Capability Boundary Review

primary_bottleneck: MIXED (L2 Case Selection + L3 Evidence Distillation)
secondary_bottleneck: L1 (Evidence/Perception — TLD, but NOT primary for human learning)

executive_summary.key_finding: Current Case Selection optimizes for GEOMETRIC AMBIGUITY, not LEARNING VALUE. 53% of cases are Type A (wasted human review). 88% TABLE content bias. TLD failure does NOT systematically produce high learning value.

Type_A.description: Machine decisive, Human snap judgment, no new info

Type_C.description: Machine error + High reuse — NOT FOUND

l5_human_behavior.implication: Distilled evidence (B2) adds cognitive load without improving accuracy

executive_summary.tld_learning_relationship: TLD failure does NOT systematically produce high learning value. 83% of TLD failures resolved as snap judgments. Learning value comes from REVIEWER DISAGREEMENT, not TLD failure.

content_type_distribution.bias: IS-11 is 88% TABLE-focused. P7 is only 22% TABLE, with 39% PROSE and 23% REFERENCE.

Type_A.description: Machine correct, human confirms in <3s, 0 expansions. Wasted review.

Type_D_LOW.description: Machine abstains, human resolves as snap judgment (<5s, 0 expansions). Temporary gain (Machine LOGIC GAP).

low_learning_cases.reason: 91% of feedback is BOUNDARY_CONFIRMATION (prior audit). HIGH info gain is TEMPORARY (Machine LOGIC GAP — would drop to LOW if Machine adds numeric detection, per Info Gain Audit).

Type_E_high_engagement.description: Genuine boundary with high human engagement (7 expansions, 30-46s)

Type_E_adjudicated_snap.description: Adjudicated (reviewer disagreement) but human resolved as snap judgment in L5

AMB-032.learning_value: HIGH — reveals evidence distillation gap (B2 fails to expose TLD different_cell info)

AMB-375.learning_value: HIGH — genuine boundary, reviewer disagreement, when should system abstain

p7_body_text_continuation.description: Prose boundary cases. IS-11 has only 3 PROSE. Could reveal sentence/paragraph boundary signals.

p7_reference_list_entry.description: Reference list boundary cases. IS-11 has 0. Could reveal citation format boundary signals.

p7_merge_cases.description: MERGE cases. IS-11 has only 2. Harder, more likely to produce boundary learning signals.

high_learning_value_missed_cases.reason_missed: Selection Filter optimizes geometric proximity (same_y, close_x). Table cells match. Prose continuation and reference entries may not match → filtered out.

tld_correct_high_learning.description: AMB-032 (evidence distillation gap, not TLD itself)

tld_missing_high_learning.description: AMB-375/418/519 — all adjudicated, learning value from REVIEWER DISAGREEMENT not TLD failure

tld_learning_relationship.conclusion: TLD Failure does NOT systematically produce high Learning Value. TLD is an independent Evidence Quality Problem (L1), NOT the human learning bottleneck (L2/L3).
tld_learning_relationship.dce07_impact: DCE-07 closed locality route. TLD failure remains unresolved but is NOT the primary human learning bottleneck.

selection_mechanism_analysis.formula: P(new info) × P(evidence-grounded) × P(reusable) × P(future benefit)

ambiguity_filter.problem: 24/45 (53%) of ambiguous cases are actually Machine-Decisive (TN)

selection_mechanism_analysis.low_value_entry_point: Ambiguity Filter — selects IS-01/IS-02 mixed cases, but IS-11 experimental_c resolves most via TLD override → 53% become Machine-Decisive

feedback_taxonomy.key_observation: 91% of feedback is BOUNDARY_CONFIRMATION — Human mainly confirms Machine

info_gain_correction.corrected_diagnosis: 60% HIGH gain (Quadrant B — Machine ambiguous, Human resolves)
info_gain_correction.correction_reason: Previous analyzed Feedback Text; current analyzes Evidence State
info_gain_correction.key_caveat: 10/10 Quadrant B HIGH gain is TEMPORARY (Machine LOGIC GAP — would drop to LOW if Machine adds numeric detection)

CS1.status: Potential Reusable Signal Candidate (NOT Reusable Knowledge)

feedback_reuse_findings.ceiling_effect: 96% KEEP_SEPARATE, 0 negative cases, 0 CONFLICT, 0 UNKNOWN in CS1 candidates

counterfactual_result.question: If selection prioritized high learning value cases, would system improvement potential increase?
supported: Human review effort would decrease (45→10-15 cases)
Feedback information gain per judgment would increase
caveats: Even high-gain cases are temporary (Machine LOGIC GAP)
Insufficient future cases for reuse validation
counterfactual_result.assessment: Counterfactual is PLAUSIBLE but UNPROVEN. Current data does not demonstrate that high-value selection would produce measurable system improvement, only that it would reduce wasted effort.

L1_evidence_value.Type_D_LOW: MEDIUM (P1/P2 exist, TLD fails or IS-11 fallback)

L2_human_review_value.Type_A: LOW (machine correct, human confirms <3s, no expansion)

L4_learning_reuse_value.Type_E: UNKNOWN (2 high-engagement but UNKNOWN, no stable signal)

AMB-262.reason: TLD page-global contamination. Human snap judgment. Temporary gain. No reusable signal.

AMB-313.reason: TLD page-global contamination. Human snap judgment with override.

AMB-462.reason: TLD Mechanism 2 (inherent low text_ratio). Human overrides cue. Case-specific.

AMB-032.reason: TLD correct but B2 evidence distillation fails to expose different_cell. Human UNKNOWN in B2. Reveals L3 gap.

AMB-375.reason: Adjudicated (reviewer disagreement). B2 UNKNOWN. Genuine boundary. When should system abstain?

AMB-008.note: Not in IS-11 GT. Analyzed in DCE-07 as negative control.
AMB-008.reason: Prose with citations. TLD correctly rejects. Underrepresented in IS-11 (only 3 PROSE).

AMB-042.note: Not in IS-11 GT. Analyzed in DCE-07 as negative control.
AMB-042.reason: Prose + table-like content. TLD correctly rejects. Underrepresented content type.

locality_safety_analysis.note: Locality safety was analyzed in DCE-07. HVA-01 does not re-analyze locality. DCE-07 conclusion: PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNSAFE, route CLOSED.

mechanism_1_tld.impact_on_human_learning: LOW — 83% of TLD failures resolved as snap judgments
mechanism_1_tld.reason: TLD failure is Evidence Quality (L1) problem. Human uses page visual, not TLD output. No reusable signal.

mechanism_2_text_ratio.impact_on_human_learning: LOW — AMB-462 resolved as snap judgment with override
mechanism_2_text_ratio.reason: Inherent TLD threshold issue. Human corrects trivially.

evidence_distillation_gap.impact_on_human_learning: HIGH — AMB-032 shows B2 fails to expose TLD different_cell
evidence_distillation_gap.reason: Evidence exists but is not distilled for human use. L3 problem.

case_selection_bias.reason: Selection optimizes geometric ambiguity, not learning value. L2 problem.

learning_signal_gate.reason: No candidate reached L4. 91% BOUNDARY_CONFIRMATION. HIGH gain temporary. No future case validation. No HRR measurement.

evidence_gaps: P7 human review data incomplete (69 cases, all labels UNKNOWN)
Single participant (P01) pilot — n=1, image confound
L5 experiment limited — 55 judgments, only 2 high engagement
No future case validation — no candidate tested on independent cases
Content type bias — IS-11 88% TABLE, P7 more diverse but no human review
No HRR measurement — no experiment measured Human Review Reduction

next_research_route.L2_contribution: Case Selection optimizes wrong metric (geometric ambiguity ≠ learning value). 53% wasted. Need value-aware selection.
next_research_route.L3_contribution: Evidence Distillation does not expose decision-relevant structure. AMB-032 proves B2 fails. Need better evidence presentation.
next_research_route.L1_contribution: TLD failure exists but NOT primary. DCE-07 closed locality route. Independent Evidence Quality problem.
next_research_route.L4_contribution: Blocked downstream. Ceiling effect, insufficient future cases. Cannot resolve until L2/L3 improve.
next_research_route.note: ROUTE E selected because no single layer explains all phenomena. L2 (wrong cases) + L3 (wrong evidence presentation) are co-primary.

final_verdict.primary_bottleneck: MIXED (L2 Case Selection + L3 Evidence Distillation)
final_verdict.secondary_bottleneck: L1 (Evidence/Perception — TLD, but NOT primary for human learning)

final_verdict.tld_relationship: INDEPENDENT — TLD failure does NOT systematically produce high learning value
